# How to publish a Learning Session
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Use this when you are an administrator and need to make a recorded Learning Session available to participants. You need the title, category, date, description, optional YouTube video URL, and optional supporting file.

1. Sign in with an administrator account.
2. Open **Admin > Sessions**.
3. Create a session and enter the required title, category, date, and description.
4. Add an optional YouTube video URL.
5. Add one optional file in PDF, DOC, DOCX, or TXT format, up to 10 MB.
6. Save the session. It is a draft and is not visible to participants.
7. Choose **Publish** when the content is ready.

Published, non-archived sessions appear in Classroom. To hide a session without deleting it, use **Unpublish**. To remove it from normal use while retaining the record, use **Archive**. Restoring an archived session removes its archived status; review its publish status before expecting participants to see it.

YouTube URLs are not guaranteed secret from authenticated participants. See [the security limit](../architecture/data-and-security.md#limits).
